results.desc:
PHASES is a three track EP shaped by contrast, emotion and different stages of personal evolution. Each track reflects a distinct emotional space. 

REQUIEM moves through darker, melancholic and introspective territory. LEAP shifts toward fast, uplifting hard-trance energy and a sense of release, while Loud Enough brings bigger vocals, heavy bass and a more intense, dramatic club feel. 

Together, the tracks represent different phases, emotions and facets of the same journey, moving between tension, resilience, release and momentum while remaining rooted in a fast, emotionally charged sound.

Distributed by Label Engine - www.label-engine.com
